name: codex-projects-plugin
description: Project Coordinator for Codex, inspired by Cursor Projects and Claude Code Projects: one coordinator chat per project, parallel Codex agents, durable memory, and a coordinator panel inside Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate long-running work across parallel agents
interface.longDescription: Talk to one coordinator per project. It delegates tasks to Codex agents in their own worktrees, tracks what needs you, and keeps project notes and memory that every agent reads.
